load it."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"`peerDependencies` deliberately declares no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` package. The installer compares
eve"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ry such peer against the running runtime version and refuses the install when it does not match,
whi"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ch would pin the plugin to one DSH release. This plugin needs nothing installed to run — the
runtime"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" packages below are already present in any DSH profile — so the check is skipped and any
runtime ver"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"sion installs. The tradeoff is deliberate: a DSH release that breaks one of those
interfaces will lo"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"ad the plugin and fail at that call, instead of being refused at install time."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Why nothing is lost"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The session log is append-only and stays the source of truth. A recall appends one event carrying
`s"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"urfaceOp: { op: 'replace', startSeq, endSeq }`, so the log keeps every event, and a reader that
igno"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"res surface ops still sees the full transcript."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Files are never unlinked. The bytes in the way move into
`$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-rewind-plugin/quara"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ntine/<session>/<slot>/` — with a `manifest.json` naming
the original path — before the before-image"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" is written back. A file the recalled range created is
moved there rather than deleted."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"A recall has to know what the range started from, so the plugin takes one bounded copy of the
worksp"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ace before a turn's first writing tool and stores it content-addressed under
`$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"-rewind-plugin/{trees,blobs}`. That copy is what makes a file a shell command
rewrote restorable: th"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"e `write` / `edit` waterfalls still supply the exact before-image for the tools
they see, and where "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"the snapshot covered a path its bytes are the ones that go back."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## For other plugins"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"A recall changes the transcript and the working tree. A plugin that mirrored a turn — a board, an
ar"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"chive, a task list — has to put its own state back too, so the host half publishes the
`dsh-rewind-p"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"articipants` service. Declare it in your `inject`, call
`register({ id, reconcileAfterRewind })`, an"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"d every recall runs your participant after the surface
write, in registration order. A participant t"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"hat throws or misses its 30-second deadline is logged and
skipped — it cannot fail the recall — and "},{"id":"p23s6","text":"the command collects each participant's result under its id
(the file revert's tally is the one that"},{"id":"p23s7","text":" rides the result). The file revert is itself the first
participant, so this is the path the plugin'"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"s own feature already uses."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## What it needs at runtime"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Resolved from the profile, never bundled:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"`@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`,
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-se"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ssion-projection`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths`,
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-c"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"onnection`, `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, `zod`."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The browser half requires only `react`, `react/jsx-runtime`, `react-dom/client` and
`@deepseek-ai/ds"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"h-client-ui-primitives`, all supplied by the shell's own module table. It does not
